_purpose: Canonical schema for a physical witness packet submitted by the KTX Tensile-Lift hardware bench. Every field is required unless marked optional. All numeric thresholds are ENGINEERING_ENVELOPE parameters and must be configured per component type — none are hardcoded here.
_security_notice: Do NOT embed private keys, calibration secrets, or production credentials in packets or test fixtures.
_encoding: JSON, UTF-8. Canonical serialization for signature: sort keys lexicographically, no whitespace, UTF-8 bytes. Signature covers all fields EXCEPT 'signature' itself.

schema_version.description: Schema version this packet conforms to. Receiver rejects mismatches.

aircraft_id.description: Canonical aircraft identifier matching the LNES-60 aircraft registry. Not the sensor device ID. Must match the claim being evaluated.

component_id.description: Canonical component identifier (e.g. TETHER-1, MOTOR-PORT-AFT). Must match the specific component the measurement covers.

sensor_id.description: Logical sensor identifier (e.g. ELONGATION-SENSOR-A). Not the device hardware ID. Registered in the sensor registry against the component.

witness_device_id.description: Physical device hardware identifier (e.g. hardware serial number or secure element ID). Separately registered against sensor_id and aircraft_id in the key registry.

measurement_type.description: What physical property is being measured. Must match sensor registry's declared measurement_type for this sensor.

measurement_value.description: Numeric measurement in the declared unit. Must be finite (not NaN or Infinity). Receiver rejects NaN/Infinity explicitly.

unit.description: Physical unit of measurement_value. Must match sensor registry declaration.

measurement_uncertainty.description: 1-sigma measurement uncertainty in the same unit. Must be non-negative and finite.

measurement_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the physical measurement event. Used for event-relative freshness and staleness evaluation.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing per-device counter. Receiver rejects rollbacks and gaps beyond the configured tolerance. Never reset without invalidating all prior replay guard state.

nonce.description: Random or counter-derived anti-replay token. Must be unique per packet from this device. Receiver tracks seen nonces and rejects duplicates.

configuration_epoch.description: Epoch identifier of the aircraft/component configuration this measurement is taken against. Receiver validates that the configuration epoch matches the commanded state for the claim being evaluated.

calibration_record_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the current calibration record for this sensor. Receiver looks up the registered calibration record and validates hash match and validity window.

calibration_valid_until.description: Expiry of the calibration record referenced by calibration_record_hash. Receiver checks this against measurement_timestamp.

firmware_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the witness device firmware at measurement time. Cross-checked against the firmware registry for this device.

witness_version.description: Witness packet protocol version implemented by the device firmware. Receiver may reject versions it does not support.

previous_witness_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical serialization of the immediately preceding packet from this device. Null for the first packet in a sequence. Chain breaks flag potential replay or physical disconnect.

signature_algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. Required value for Phase 2: Ed25519. Receiver rejects unknown algorithms.

signature_key_id.description: Key identifier used to look up the public key in the receiver's key registry. The private key must never appear in the packet or logs.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonical serialization of all other fields (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8). Covers everything except this field itself.

_thresholds_note: No numeric safety thresholds (elongation limits, calibration windows, staleness windows) are hardcoded in this schema. All are ENGINEERING_ENVELOPE parameters configured per component type in the receiver's configuration files.
_private_key_discipline: Private keys used to generate signatures MUST NOT appear in packet data, logs, test fixtures, or any committed file. Use TEST-KEY-ONLY-labeled ephemeral keys for all bench validation runs.
